subject: Can't seem to get the latest version of shiny installed

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Can't seem to get the latest version of shiny installed
parts: In my R installation I see shiny packages (multiple) 0.3.0, 0.4.0,0.5.0.   I remove 0.3.0.  I re-install shiny-server using npm.  I restart shiny-server.  The terminal shows version 0.3.0 and none of the examples run because they require 0.3.4 at a minimum.  I suspect the problem is that Linux, Node AND shiny are new to me. :)
